description: Use this when the user wants to play a word-guessing puzzle in the chat: either a puzzle share link someone sent them (made with this app), or a random common five-letter word ('unlimited' practice). Shows a playable grid with six guesses; the answer is not included in the reply to you. Does not open puzzles from other websites and does not reveal answers or give hints.

puzzle_link.description: A puzzle share link made by this app, e.g. https://word-guess.zovo.one/dl/play/s.AbC123... Leave it out to play a random common 5-letter word.

name: show_word_puzzle
title: Show word puzzle
